deadline.value: Apply by December 15 (2026) for Fall 2027; fall entry only.
deadline.quote: Admit Term: Fall semester only | Application Deadline: December 15

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but scores are reviewed if you send them.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores are optional but may be reviewed if submitted.

supervisor.value: Traditional MS/PhD applicants are reviewed as one pool by the department; no advisor agreement is required.
supervisor.quote: applicants are reviewed for admission as one applicant pool regardless of their intention on pursuing the MS or PhD.

funding.value: Many admitted students get a four-year funding guarantee (usually TAships first); funding decisions come with the admission decision.
funding.quote: Many students admitted to the traditional MS/PhD track are offered a funding guarantee of four years through the department, typically in the form of teaching assistantships for incoming students.

also.quote: We offer financial support to a large number of our admitted students in the form of teaching assistantships, research assistantships and/or competitive fellowships.

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's to the single traditional MS/PhD track; you need programming, data structures, machine organization and calculus-level maths.
entry_route.quote: At a minimum, the applicant should have some programming experience, including courses in data structures and machine organization, along with a year of college-level mathematics at the calculus level or above.

fee_waiver.value: The department gives no fee waivers; only Graduate School fee grants (US citizens/permanent residents) apply.
fee_waiver.quote: No, the department does not offer fee waivers to applicants.

notes: Traditional CS MS/PhD is one admissions track.
